question: Who is the author of 'Introduction to Khadia Language'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__G.C. Banerjee__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Khadia tribe belongs to the Proto-Austroloid species.**
 
• Their language is called **Khadia language, which is a dialect of the intermediate Munda language**.
 
• **The beginning of Khadiya Shishta literature is believed to be around 1866 AD. In 1894 AD. GC Banerjee wrote "Indroduction to Khadia Language.**
 
• Flor Cheishans and Duart composed the Kharia Dictionary.
 
• In 1937 AD. SC. Rai's book "The Khadias was published from the Catholic Press Ranchi, which carries folk songs, folk tales and mantras.
 
• In 1942 AD, W.C. Archer published a book called 'Khadia Oolong. This book is a compilation of Khadia folk songs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Khadia Literature**

 
 
• ​Khadia folk literature divides into folksongs, folktales, folklore, etc.
 
• The themes of Khadia folk songs are **history, habitat, migration. war, life philosophy, caste system, social system, love, bliss, sorrow, religion, nature, fauna, etc.**
 
• In Khadia folk literature, there are **ghost stories, monster stories, animal, bird stories, trees and sapling stories, fasting stories, stories of sages and saints, jokes, and proverbs.**
 
• After the independence and establishment of Adivasi Patrika' and All India Radio, the development of Khadia elegant literature started growing rapidly.
 
• Poems, stories, andarticles of **Pyare Kerketta, Saroj Kerketta, Rose Kerketta, Gloria Soren** were published in the tribal magazine. Magazines named "**Tardi and Johar**'' were published in Khadia language.
 
• **At present, among the Kharia writers the names of R. P. Sahu. Vandana Tete. Pushpa Tete, Marry S. Soren, Juel Soreng are notable.**
